_doc: Limbs torn off (specification 003 T008, Prender-263): a blow of force 10 on the street corner at (60, 8), where people walk, the camera on the corner before it so the walkers are drawn; three seconds after it, the body nearest where the bodies lie (60, -25: setView's y is the map's north, -z, where the blow's {at: [x, z]} is not; they land some 15 m off the blow) (setViewNear body: the effects' whole bodies, their torn limbs by them) near (60 px a metre) from 45 degrees at four azimuths: each limb that came off a piece of the same body, its own skin and clothes, lying apart; from above, mid (20). The pieces counted (effects_bodies_census).
